title: Cap concurrent runs and bound compile memory
description: From the M1 review: the server has no concurrency cap, and prlimit is applied to the program but not to the compiler, so a heavy template compile can use unbounded memory. Add a per-session concurrency limit and apply memory/CPU limits to the compile step. Specify with Gherkin first.
right_now_summary: The server lacks a run cap, and compiler memory and CPU limits are not enforced.
